scenarios.title: A｜钱包
scenarios.setting: 玩家在人多的地方发现钱包不见了，怀疑被偷。

turns.text: Excuse me. I think my wallet has been stolen.
Are you sure you didn’t just lose it?

turns.prompt: 你想补充自己最后一次带着钱包的时间线索，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m pretty sure I had it when I came in.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m pretty sure I had it when I came in.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: I checked my bag, and it’s definitely gone.

feedback.naturalExpression: I checked my bag, and it’s definitely gone.
feedback.explanation: 提供自己经历或做过的具体情况，让对方能在已知信息上继续确认。

choices.text: I remember putting it in my pocket about twenty minutes ago.

feedback.naturalExpression: I remember putting it in my pocket about twenty minutes ago.
feedback.explanation: “I remember”说明自己记得的情况，便于与对方一起核对经过。

choices.text: I’m not completely sure, but I think someone may have taken it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not completely sure, but I think someone may have taken it.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: My wallet was stolen by someone, I think.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’m pretty sure I had it when I came in.
feedback.explanation: 这句能表达怀疑遭窃；把“I think”放前面，并省去不提供信息的“by someone”，会更简洁。

turns.text: Where were you when you last had it?

turns.prompt: 对方在确认位置或去向，你会怎样说清楚地点？

choices.text: I last used it at the café downstairs.

feedback.naturalExpression: I last used it at the café downstairs.
feedback.explanation: “downstairs”指楼上或楼下，是建筑内部说明方向的常见用词。

choices.text: I had it when I paid for something about half an hour ago.

feedback.naturalExpression: I had it when I paid for something about half an hour ago.
feedback.explanation: “I paid”交代已使用的付款方式，方便查账或办理退款。

choices.text: I think I still had it when I got on the train.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I still had it when I got on the train.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I’m not sure exactly when it disappeared.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure exactly when it disappeared.
feedback.explanation: 明确表达不确定，让对方知道需要进一步确认，而不是把猜测当作事实。

turns.prompt: 你想补充遗失钱包里有哪些物品，会怎么说？

choices.text: Some cash, two bank cards, and my ID.

feedback.naturalExpression: Some cash, two bank cards, and my ID.
feedback.explanation: “cash”指现金，是说明付款方式的直接用词。

choices.text: Mostly cards. There wasn’t much cash in it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Mostly cards. There wasn’t much cash in it.
feedback.explanation: “mostly”限定为主要情况，说明还有其他可能，而不是一概而论。

choices.text: My credit card and driver’s license were inside.

feedback.naturalExpression: My credit card and driver’s license were inside.
feedback.explanation: “driver’s license”是驾驶执照，说明失物中的证件有助于辨认身份。

turns.text: You should report it and contact your bank as soon as possible.

turns.prompt: 你想了解钱包失窃后应先办理哪些事，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. Where can I report the theft?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Where can I report the theft?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: Thanks. I’ll contact my bank right away.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I’ll contact my bank right away.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: B｜手机
scenarios.setting: 玩家在街上发现手机不见了。

turns.text: I think someone stole my phone.
When did you last see it?

turns.prompt: 关于「东西被偷」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: I had it a few minutes ago when we were outside the station.

feedback.naturalExpression: I had it a few minutes ago when we were outside the station.
feedback.explanation: “a few”表示少量，后接可数名词复数；比只说“一些”更偏向数量不多。

choices.text: I used it just before we got on the train.

feedback.naturalExpression: I used it just before we got on the train.
feedback.explanation: “I used”交代之前采用的信息或方法，便于对方核对记录。

choices.text: I think it disappeared while we were in the crowd.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think it disappeared while we were in the crowd.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I’m not sure. I only just noticed it was gone.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure. I only just noticed it was gone.
feedback.explanation: 明确表达不确定，让对方知道需要进一步确认，而不是把猜测当作事实。

choices.text: My phone disappeared just now.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I had it a few minutes ago when we were outside the station.
feedback.explanation: “disappeared”只说不见了，不等于确定被偷；如果只是找不到，先说明丢失并核查经过。

turns.prompt: 你想尝试通过拨打手机寻找遗失的设备，会怎么说？

choices.text: Not yet. Can I use your phone to call mine?

feedback.naturalExpression: Not yet. Can I use your phone to call mine?
feedback.explanation: “not yet”表示目前还没有，但之后仍可能发生；与绝对否定不同。

choices.text: Yeah, but no one’s answering.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, but no one’s answering.
feedback.explanation: 转折后的内容说明当前需要注意的不同情况，能把顾虑或限制说清楚。

choices.text: I tried, but it seems to be turned off now.

feedback.naturalExpression: I tried, but it seems to be turned off now.
feedback.explanation: 把结论说成基于现有信息的判断，给后续核实或纠正留出余地。

choices.text: Could I borrow your phone to see if I can locate mine?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I borrow your phone to see if I can locate mine?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

turns.text: Sure. Do you want to report it?

turns.prompt: 关于「东西被偷」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah. I think I should report it to the police.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah. I think I should report it to the police.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Yes. I also need to contact my mobile provider.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I also need to contact my mobile provider.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: I want to check with the station staff first, just in case someone turned it in.

feedback.naturalExpression: I want to check with the station staff first, just in case someone turned it in.
feedback.explanation: “turned it in”在失物情景中表示把捡到的物品交给工作人员。

scenarios.title: C｜护照
scenarios.setting: 玩家旅行途中发现护照不见了。

turns.text: Excuse me. My passport has been stolen.
When did you notice it was missing?

turns.prompt: 对方在确认时间或时长，你会怎样补充信息？

choices.text: I noticed about ten minutes ago.

feedback.naturalExpression: I noticed about ten minutes ago.
feedback.explanation: “I noticed”把话题建立在自己观察到的现象上，适合开始说明问题。

choices.text: I had it with me this morning, but now it’s gone.

feedback.naturalExpression: I had it with me this morning, but now it’s gone.
feedback.explanation: “this morning”明确是哪一天的时段，谈当前日期时前面不必加介词。

choices.text: I think it was taken while I was on the train.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think it was taken while I was on the train.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I’m not sure whether it was lost or stolen.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure whether it was lost or stolen.
feedback.explanation: 明确表达不确定，让对方知道需要进一步确认，而不是把猜测当作事实。

choices.text: I lost my passport by someone.

feedback.naturalExpression: I noticed about ten minutes ago.
feedback.explanation: “lost … by someone”不能表达被偷；确定遭窃用“My passport was stolen”，不确定则说明护照不见了。

turns.text: Do you have any other identification?

turns.prompt: 关于「东西被偷」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: I have a photo of my passport on my phone.

feedback.naturalExpression: I have a photo of my passport on my phone.
feedback.explanation: 交代与当前有关的经历或已完成的事，让对方了解这次沟通的背景。

choices.text: I have my driver’s license with me.

feedback.naturalExpression: I have my driver’s license with me.
feedback.explanation: “driver’s license”是驾驶执照，说明失物中的证件有助于辨认身份。

choices.text: I don’t have another ID with me.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t have another ID with me.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

choices.text: I have a copy of my passport information page.

feedback.naturalExpression: I have a copy of my passport information page.
feedback.explanation: 交代与当前有关的经历或已完成的事，让对方了解这次沟通的背景。

turns.text: You’ll need to report the missing passport.

turns.prompt: 你想了解护照遗失后在哪里报案、需要什么信息，会怎么说？

choices.text: Where can I file a police report?

feedback.naturalExpression: Where can I file a police report?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: What information will I need to provide?

feedback.naturalExpression: What information will I need to provide?
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: Can you tell me where the nearest police station is?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can you tell me where the nearest police station is?
feedback.explanation: “Can you …?”直接请对方帮忙，是常见口语请求；使用“can”本身并不等于不礼貌。

choices.text: I’ll also need to contact my embassy or consulate, right?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ll also need to contact my embassy or consulate, right?
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。
